# JAIPORE Xpress

> Indian eatery with locations across CT and NY — samosas, curries, dosas, and takeout-focused Indian dining.

## Locations
- Ridgefield, CT: 19 Bailey Ave, Ridgefield, CT 06877. Phone: (203) 403-3997.
- Briarcliff, NY: 1116 Pleasantville Rd, Briarcliff, NY. Phone: (914) 373-4821.
- Guilford, CT: 33 Water Street, Unit A, Guilford, CT. Phone: (203) 533-7040.
- Brookfield, CT: 782 Federal Rd, Brookfield, CT. Phone: (203) 546-7446.
- Bedford Hills, NY: 740 N Bedford Rd, Bedford Hills, NY. Phone: (914) 218-3262.

## Hours (Ridgefield)
- Monday–Sunday: 11:30 AM – 8:30 PM
